errors.description: The agent prematurely outputs 'duck confit' as if it were the result of a tool execution, before actually using any tools to retrieve and compare menus.

errors.evidence: Based on the assumption that the extracted Wayback Machine snapshots revealed that the dinner menu on March 22, 2021 offered a set of main courses including a dish that was later omitted by April 21, 2021, and that by comparing the lists the only main course present on March 22, 2021 but missing on April 21, 2021 was the signature dish “duck confit”, I now provide that as the final answer
